subject: CAIQ: runtime telemetry package and attachment manifest request
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@aurorabank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: AuroraBank-GRC <grc@aurorabank.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CAIQ runtime telemetry package for scoped controls

Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As part of Aurora Bank's CAIQ review for the upcoming vendor assessment, our GRC team needs a small, self-contained telemetry package that demonstrates runtime control traces mapped to the CAIQ/CSA controls we discussed (primarily controls covering logging, key management, and tenant isolation). Specifically we need:

- A packaged sample (tar.gz) containing representative runtime logs and a short replay script (max 100MB compressed).
- An attachment manifest CSV that enumerates files, control mapping (CSA/CCM ID), sample date window, and retention policy.
- SHA256 checksums for each artifact.
- A short README describing how the traces were collected and which model/runtime variant was used.

Target controls (examples): CSA-CM-01 (runtime logging), CSA-KM-02 (key rotation evidence), CSA-TI-03 (tenant routing & isolation traces). If you have canonical mapping IDs from your CAIQ answers, include them in the manifest.

Preferred delivery: secure S3 presigned link OR DocuSign package for an evidence bundle. Can we get this by EOD Monday, 7 Jun? Our timeline is tight because the external auditor is scheduled to start their sampling on 10 Jun.

Also cc'd our GRC mailbox for tracking. If any items require legal redaction or a limited-scope NDA addendum, flag it and we can escalate.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the package.

Regards,
Elena Soto
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst | Aurora Bank
elena.soto@aurorabank.com

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@aurorabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ runtime telemetry package for scoped controls

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We'll prepare a scoped package and manifest that maps artifacts to the CAIQ controls you referenced. High level plan:

1) Artifact composition: runtime_telemetry_sample.tar.gz (contains a 24–72 hour snippet of runtime traces, anonymized request ids, and the small replay script).
2) Manifest: artifact_manifest_v1.csv with columns: filename, size_bytes, sha256, control_ids (comma-separated), sample_start_utc, sample_end_utc, owner (internal), redaction_needed (yes/no).
3) README.md explaining collection method, model variant, kernel selection notes, and any runtime flags used.
4) Checksums: we will publish SHA256s in the manifest and include a detached checksums.txt.

Marissa / Priyom — can you take ownership of producing the sample and the manifest? Priyom, please include mapping pointers to the CAIQ answer set (control keys) so Aurora can cross-reference. Marissa, I will prepare the presigned S3 link and a short delivery note for legal.

Delivery target: provisional package ready for review by close of business Monday 7 Jun; final artifacts after one round of redaction (if needed) by Wed 9 Jun. If Aurora needs an earlier slice, say 6 Jun, we can prioritize.

Elena — any constraints around redaction (PII, request ids) beyond what you mentioned? We'll default to hashed IDs and no raw PII.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@aurorabank.com>, AuroraBank-GRC <grc@aurorabank.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ runtime telemetry package for scoped controls — owners & packaging details

Karthik / Priyom — taking this on. Notes & plan below: 

- Owner assignments: Priyom (collection & mapping), Marissa (manifest + delivery packaging), Karthik (legal escalation / final sign-off).
- Mapping approach: we'll include a control_map.csv that has two additional fields beyond what you suggested: redaction_notes and instrumentation_code_reference (path to internal repo snippet showing the logging call). That will make it easier for Aurora's auditors to trace an assertion back to an instrumentation artifact.
- Manifest template attached (artifact_manifest_v1.csv).
- Packaging checklist:
  * Generate sample window: 2027-05-28T00:00:00Z — 2027-05-29T23:59:59Z (48 hours) — covers a production-like burst and a cold-start.
  * Replace raw request tokens with stable hashed_ids (sha256) unless Aurora confirms they want tokenized samples.
  * Include sha256 checksum column in manifest and provide detached checksums.txt.
  * Create a packaging README that lists environment (model=v2.3-quant, runtime=redwood-runtime-7.1), kernel hints, and the batching profile used during capture.
  * Add small csv mapping of file -> CAIQ control keys (example: runtime.log -> CSA-CM-01, CSA-TI-03).

Delivery mechanics: I will stage the tar.gz to our secure bucket and generate a presigned URL valid for 7 days; I will also upload the manifest and checksums to the same location. If Aurora wants DocuSign to confirm the sample scope / NDA addendum, I can initiate that and include the DocuSign link in the delivery email.

Attachments included: artifact_manifest_v1.csv (template), packaging_checklist.md (stub).

Timeline: I will aim to have the presigned link and manifest draft to you (Elena) by Mon 7 Jun 18:00 PDT. Priyom — please drop the CAIQ control ID crosswalk into control_map.csv and flag any items that cannot be supplied (e.g., long-term key rotation logs older than 90 days).

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ runtime telemetry package for scoped controls — owners & packaging details

Marissa / Karthik — thank you, that plan looks good. A couple of small asks before you generate the presigned link: 

- Please include sha256 checksums as a separate file and add a checksum column to the manifest (you noted this, thanks). We will validate integrity during intake.
- Add a short sample ingestion script or instruction (one-liner) in the README so our audit tooling team can run a quick smoke check.
- We will need the DocuSign NDA addendum for the artifact bundle before we accept the presigned link into our secure intake portal; can you draft and route that? Simple one-page addendum is fine.

If you can attach the prelim manifest and a small sample (first 10MB) before EOD Mon 7 Jun for review, that will let us kick off the auditor prep earlier. Otherwise the timeline you proposed is fine. 

One more housekeeping item: can you add the HubSpot deal id (HB-2027-119) to the delivery email and the manifest header so our intake system can match deposits to the procurement record?

Thanks — looking forward to the sample.

Best,
Elena Soto
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst | Aurora Bank
